name: DFO/CHS Canadian Tides
description: Tide predictions and water-level observations for Canadian coastal waters and the Great Lakes from the Canadian Hydrographic Service Integrated Water Level System (IWLS). Surfaces in the place panel for coastal Canadian places.

dfo-iwls.purpose: Tide predictions and high/low events for Canadian places near a CHS station.
dfo-iwls.dataSent: Latitude/longitude (rounded to 4 decimals) or station ID.
dfo-iwls.dataReceived: High/low tide events for today + tomorrow, 30-min tide curve, and the latest observed water level when available.
